name: Magnesium Bisglycinate + B6
subtitle: 60 capsules · 30 day supply

benefits.title: Energy Metabolism
benefits.desc: B6 converts food into cellular energy

ingredients: Magnesium Bisglycinate 400mg (providing 80mg elemental magnesium), Pyridoxine HCl (Vitamin B6) 10mg. Bisglycinate form is 4× more bioavailable than magnesium oxide and does not cause digestive discomfort.
howToUse: Take 2 capsules 30 minutes before bed with warm water. For daytime stress relief, take 1 capsule in the morning and 1 before bed. Do not exceed 2 capsules per day.
